info.title: Media Viewer API
info.description: REST API for Media Viewer - A self-hosted media library browser with WebAuthn/Passkey authentication support

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Ordered media collections and membership management

post.description: Creates the first user account. Only available when no users exist.

400.description: Invalid request or setup already completed

post.description: Authenticate using password and receive a session cookie

get.description: Verify if the current session is valid

put.description: Update the user's password. Requires current password verification. Invalidates all sessions.

get.summary: Check if passkey login is available
get.description: Returns whether WebAuthn is enabled and credentials are registered

available.description: True if WebAuthn is enabled AND credentials exist

enabled.description: True if WebAuthn is configured on the server

post.description: Starts the WebAuthn registration ceremony. Returns challenge data for the browser.
Verifies the credential from the browser and stores the passkey
Starts the WebAuthn authentication ceremony. Returns challenge data.
Verifies the credential and creates an authenticated session

get.description: Returns all passkeys registered for the current user

delete.description: Removes a registered passkey by ID

get.description: Browse directory contents with pagination and filtering
Returns path, name, and type for directory entries without full metadata.
Retrieve a specific file by path

get.summary: List media files for lightbox navigation
get.description: Returns only image and video entries from a directory with offset-based pagination.
Returns a thumbnail image. Generates if not exists.

post.description: Triggers full thumbnail regeneration in background

get.description: Returns all collections with item counts and folder scope metadata.

post.description: Creates a new collection and can optionally seed it with media items. Collections are folder-scoped and names must be unique.

400.description: Invalid request body or missing collection name

409.description: Collection name conflict or cross-folder conflict

post.summary: Get collection memberships for multiple files
post.description: Returns a map of file paths to the collection IDs that currently contain each file.

200.description: Membership map keyed by file path

get.summary: Get a collection with its items
get.description: Returns collection metadata together with the collection's ordered media items.

put.description: Renames a collection and can update its cover image.

400.description: Invalid collection ID or request body

delete.description: Deletes a collection and its membership records, without deleting the underlying media files.

post.description: Adds one or more media paths to an existing collection. Collections cannot span folders.

400.description: Invalid collection ID or empty paths array

delete.description: Removes one or more media paths from an existing collection.

400.description: Invalid collection ID or empty paths array

put.description: Replaces the stored item order for an existing collection.

400.description: Invalid collection ID or empty paths array

put.summary: Set all tags for a file
put.description: Replaces all tags for a file with the provided list

post.description: Returns tags that frequently co-occur with the provided tags, excluding tags already selected or explicitly excluded.

500.description: Failed to get related tag suggestions

post.summary: Create or reuse an HLS session

width.description: Target stream width; 0 keeps source width

get.summary: Get files with a specific tag

delete.description: Removes the tag from all files

get.description: Returns video stream with transcoding if needed
Returns metadata about the video stream

post.description: Forces a full scan of the media directory

paths.description: Optional initial media paths to add to the collection

coverPath.description: Optional explicit cover image path when updating a collection

folderPath.description: Optional folder scope for empty or newly created collections

paths.description: Full collection item order, from first to last
Media file paths to check for collection membership

exclude.description: Additional tag names to suppress from the response

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return

itemCount.description: Total number of items using this tag

relatedCount.description: Number of items where this tag appears alongside the requested tags
